text.c06: [softly] …Where is this? So many lights, like stars.
text.c07: [concerned] My lord, the air is cold… yet something smells good.
text.c11: [proudly] So this is a tavern of the new age. Small, but full of life!
text.c15: [excited] Golden sake pouring from a barrel! What is this foam!?
text.c25: [politely] Charcoal-grilled. Eat it while it's hot.
text.c28: [whispers] My lord has a cat's tongue — let's blow on it for him.
text.c33: [suspicious] And what's this? The ice is singing… fizzing.
text.c34: [excited] So refreshing my throat could freeze!
text.c37: [calmly] Hot sake for me… ah, it warms me to the core.
text.c39: [whispers] Ieyasu — still cautious after four hundred years.
text.c43: [thoughtfully] The lights of Kyoto on the river… so this is what the realm became.
text.c45: [softly] No one carries a sword… It is a good age.
text.c56: [politely] It was a joyful night. Call us again.
text.c58: [warmly] Next time, take us to where good sake is born!
